name: sureneco
description: 5ch雀魂スレッドの友人戦募集通知
author: sakots

scripts.test: pnpm build:server && vitest run && pnpm build:backend && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:server: pnpm build:server && vitest run tests/node-server.test.ts tests/node-api.test.ts tests/device-auth.test.ts tests/web-push.test.ts tests/ntfy*.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && vite build && pnpm build:backend
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm build && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && pnpm theme:check && pnpm format:check && git diff --check
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts server/*.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts server/*.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json
